items.reason_en: Improper path equivalence resolution in WebDAV enables authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. This flaw circumvents directory restrictions and facilitates lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中不当的路径等价性解析使已授权攻击者可通过网络提升权限。该漏洞绕过了目录限制并促进了横向移动。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerabilities in ASP.NET Core directly impact modern web application frameworks, allowing remote attackers to inject and execute malicious code over the network.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的代码注入漏洞直接影响现代 Web 应用框架，使远程攻击者能够通过网络注入并执行恶意代码。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to bypass security controls and tamper with web traffic, enabling cache poisoning and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞使攻击者能够绕过安全控制并篡改 Web 流量，从而导致缓存投毒与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables email spoofing and targeted phishing campaigns within enterprise communication channels.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可在企业通信渠道内实现邮件伪造与定向钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: XSS in ASP.NET Core during web page generation allows unauthorized client-side code execution by malicious actors targeting web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 在生成网页时存在的 XSS 漏洞，使针对 Web 应用的恶意行为者能够未经授权执行客户端代码。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to pivot internally and access restricted backend resources or metadata.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞使已认证攻击者能够向内网进行横向移动，并访问受限的后端资源或元数据。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables unauthenticated attackers to perform spoofing and steal credentials or inject malicious content via web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中 CVSS 8.1 的跨站脚本漏洞使未认证攻击者能够通过 Web 界面实施伪造、窃取凭证或注入恶意内容。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Microsoft Exchange Server allows privilege escalation over the network. Compromised credentials or misconfigurations could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive email data and internal networks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的弱身份验证漏洞可通过网络实现提权。凭证泄露或配置错误可能导致对敏感邮件数据及内网的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Unauthenticated or improperly authenticated users could escalate privileges to manipulate or exfiltrate site content.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失的授权机制可通过网络实现提权。未认证或认证不当的用户可能提升权限以操纵或外泄站点内容。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution. Attackers can craft malicious payloads to achieve arbitrary code execution on the web server.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行。攻击者可构造恶意载荷以在 Web 服务器上实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows privilege escalation over the network. Exploiting this flaw could grant attackers database-level access to extract or modify critical organizational data.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞可通过网络实现提权。利用此漏洞可使攻击者获得数据库级访问权限，从而提取或修改关键组织数据。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows security feature bypass. Attackers can manipulate traffic routing to evade WAFs or inject malicious requests to backend services.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞可导致安全功能被绕过。攻击者可操纵流量路由以规避 WAF，或向后端服务注入恶意请求。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core enables privilege escalation over the network. Flawed authentication logic could allow unauthorized users to assume elevated roles within web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的身份验证缺陷可通过网络实现提权。有缺陷的身份验证逻辑可能使未授权用户获取 Web 应用内的更高角色权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in IIS allows network RCE. As the default Microsoft web server, this flaw directly exposes public-facing and internal web applications to full system takeover.
items.reason_zh: IIS 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。作为微软默认 Web 服务器，该漏洞直接使面向公网和内网的 Web 应用面临被完全接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper path resolution in WebDAV enables network RCE. WebDAV is frequently exposed externally, making this a prime vector for remote exploitation without authentication.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中不当的路径解析可导致网络远程代码执行。WebDAV 常被外部暴露，使其成为无需认证即可进行远程利用的主要途径。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in WebDAV allows network privilege escalation. Attackers can leverage this to gain elevated permissions on web servers hosting collaborative content.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致网络提权。攻击者可借此在托管协作内容的 Web 服务器上获取更高权限。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SharePoint permits network RCE. SharePoint deployments often handle sensitive corporate documents, and this flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞允许网络远程代码执行。SharePoint 部署通常处理敏感的企业文档，该漏洞使未认证攻击者能够远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Power Apps enables network RCE. Low-origin checks in modern web platforms frequently lead to cross-site scripting and remote code execution, posing significant risks to SaaS deployments.
items.reason_zh: Power Apps 中的源验证错误可导致网络远程代码执行。现代 Web 平台中薄弱的源检查常引发跨站脚本和远程代码执行，对 SaaS 部署构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Gateway allows network RCE. RD Gateway is a common internet-facing entry point for remote workforces, making this vulnerability highly attractive to threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。RD Gateway 是远程办公团队常见的互联网入口，该漏洞对威胁行为体极具吸引力。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET allows unauthenticated denial of service over the network, impacting web applications and backend services relying on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中低效的算法复杂度可导致网络未授权拒绝服务攻击，影响依赖该框架的 Web 应用与后端服务。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge permits remote attackers to execute code by exploiting malicious web content or compromised sites.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 中的堆溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过利用恶意 Web 内容或受陷网站来执行代码。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation limits in ASP.NET Core can be exploited for denial-of-service attacks against web applications, disrupting service availability.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源分配限制可被利用于针对 Web 应用的拒绝服务攻击，从而破坏服务可用性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized remote code execution, threatening developer environments and source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，威胁开发者环境及源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded JWT secrets in AJ-Report enable offline token forgery and unauthenticated remote code execution via Groovy script injection.
items.reason_zh: AJ-Report 中硬编码的 JWT 密钥支持离线令牌伪造，并通过 Groovy 脚本注入实现未授权的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Jpom allows unauthenticated attackers to gain super-administrator access by manipulating query conditions in session tokens.
items.reason_zh: Jpom中的认证绕过漏洞允许未认证攻击者通过操纵会话令牌中的查询条件获取超级管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Code injection in ShowDoc’s Mock feature permits authenticated users to execute shell commands through crafted template payloads.
items.reason_zh: ShowDoc的Mock功能存在代码注入漏洞，允许已认证用户通过构造的模板载荷执行Shell命令。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in Thelia allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts via customer names, compromising administrator sessions.
items.reason_zh: Thelia中存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞，允许未认证攻击者通过客户名称注入恶意脚本，从而劫持管理员会话。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Visual Studio Code undermines built-in security controls, enabling attackers to manipulate development workspaces and inject malicious extensions.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的权限绕过漏洞削弱了内置安全控制机制，使攻击者能够篡改开发工作区并注入恶意扩展。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office SharePoint facilitate phishing and credential theft by allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts into web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者在Web界面中注入恶意脚本，从而导致网络钓鱼和凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: URL Moniker heap overflow enables unauthenticated network code execution when browsers or applications process malicious links or web content.
items.reason_zh: 当浏览器或应用程序处理恶意链接或Web内容时，URL Moniker堆溢出漏洞可导致未认证的网络代码执行。

items.reason_en: HTTP.sys integer overflow allows network privilege escalation, potentially destabilizing web server operations and enabling unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys整数溢出漏洞可导致网络权限提升，可能破坏Web服务器运行稳定性并实现未授权访问。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in VS Code allows security feature bypass, impacting developer toolchains exposed to web protocols.
items.reason_zh: VS Code中的HTTP请求/响应走私漏洞可绕过安全特性，影响暴露于Web协议的开发者工具链。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in VS Code enables unauthorized internal network access, exploiting web-based development workflows.
items.reason_zh: VS Code中的服务端请求伪造漏洞可利用基于Web的开发工作流实现未授权的内部网络访问。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in VS Code allows security feature bypass, potentially exposing sensitive project files via crafted requests.
items.reason_zh: VS Code中的路径遍历漏洞可绕过安全特性，通过构造的请求潜在地泄露敏感项目文件。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables spoofing and credential theft against web-accessed mail clients, facilitating phishing attacks within enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的跨站脚本漏洞可对Web访问的邮件客户端实施欺骗和凭据窃取，助长企业环境内的网络钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the JScript engine enables remote code execution through malicious web-delivered scripts.
items.reason_zh: JScript引擎中的堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意Web投递的脚本实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the imaging component is highly exploitable via web-browsed or email-delivered image content.
items.reason_zh: 图像组件中的缓冲区溢出漏洞极易被利用，攻击者可通过Web浏览或邮件投递的图片内容触发该漏洞。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted mass assignment in NextGEN Gallery enables remote code execution. Compromised WordPress plugins directly threaten web application integrity and backend server access.
items.reason_zh: NextGEN Gallery中的无限制批量赋值漏洞可导致远程代码执行。被攻陷的WordPress插件直接威胁Web应用完整性及后端服务器访问权限。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in WP Directory Kit allows unauthorized database queries. Highlights persistent injection vulnerabilities in widely used content management system extensions.
items.reason_zh: WP Directory Kit中的SQL注入漏洞允许未授权数据库查询。凸显了广泛使用的CMS扩展中持续存在的注入漏洞风险。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in Debug Log Manager facilitates session hijacking. Demonstrates how inadequate output escaping in logging tools creates client-side attack vectors.
items.reason_zh: Debug Log Manager中的存储型跨站脚本漏洞易导致会话劫持。揭示了日志工具中输出转义不足如何形成客户端攻击面。

items.reason_en: Predictable staging paths during core upgrades enable unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising widely deployed CMS installations.
items.reason_zh: 核心升级过程中可预测的暂存路径可导致未认证远程代码执行，危及广泛部署的CMS安装实例。

items.reason_en: Missing server-side file allowlists permit unrestricted uploads, allowing attackers to deploy web shells and achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 缺失服务端文件白名单导致上传不受限，攻击者可借此部署Web Shell并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: PHP object injection via unsanitized customer notes enables remote code execution and arbitrary data manipulation in WooCommerce stores.
items.reason_zh: 未经过滤的客户备注导致的PHP对象注入漏洞可在WooCommerce商店中实现远程代码执行及任意数据篡改。

items.reason_en: Hook implementation flaw grants unauthorized file access by returning non-empty headers, effectively bypassing intended permission checks.
items.reason_zh: Hook实现缺陷通过返回非空头信息授予未授权的文件访问权限，有效绕过了预期的权限检查。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Apache Thrift Java bindings can trigger stack exhaustion leading to denial of service. This RPC middleware flaw impacts services handling deeply nested or malicious serialization payloads.
items.reason_zh: Apache Thrift Java绑定中的无限递归可触发栈耗尽导致拒绝服务。此RPC中间件缺陷会影响处理深层嵌套或恶意序列化载荷的服务。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in the .NET Framework allows unauthorized tampering over the network. Runtime framework weaknesses can undermine application logic integrity and data consistency.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中的输入验证不当允许通过网络进行未授权篡改。运行时框架缺陷会破坏应用逻辑完整性与数据一致性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET allows remote code execution, severely threatening backend application frameworks and microservices.
items.reason_zh: .NET中反序列化不受信任的数据可导致远程代码执行，严重威胁后端应用框架及微服务架构。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in .NET Framework poses critical risks to legacy enterprise middleware and service deployments relying on insecure data parsing.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中的反序列化缺陷对依赖不安全数据解析的传统企业中间件及服务部署构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly endangering database infrastructure and sensitive data stores.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程代码执行，直接危及数据库基础设施及敏感数据存储。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in .NET Framework allows network-based privilege elevation, affecting framework-dependent enterprise services and APIs.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中的整数溢出漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升，影响依赖该框架的企业服务与API。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 insecure deserialization in SQL Server allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, risking full database compromise, data exfiltration, and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中CVSS评分为8.8的不安全反序列化漏洞允许已认证远程攻击者执行任意代码，可能导致数据库完全沦陷、数据外泄及横向移动。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in .NET allows remote code execution. Vulnerabilities in the core runtime can be exploited by malicious assemblies or crafted inputs to compromise host systems.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行。核心运行时中的漏洞可被恶意程序集或构造的输入利用，从而攻破主机系统。

items.reason_en: Improperly implemented security check in .NET enables remote code execution. Bypassed security validations in the framework can lead to arbitrary code execution in deployed applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET中安全校验实现不当可导致远程代码执行。框架中被绕过的安全验证可能致使已部署的应用程序执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in .NET allows remote code execution. Similar to other runtime flaws, this highlights systemic risks in managed code execution environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行。与其他运行时缺陷类似，此漏洞凸显了托管代码执行环境中的系统性风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in ASP.NET Core/.NET runtime allows privilege escalation. Spoofed authentication headers or tokens could grant unauthorized access to protected resources.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core/.NET 运行时中的伪造认证绕过可导致权限提升。伪造的认证头或令牌可能授予对受保护资源的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager allows privilege escalation over an adjacent network. Attackers on the same network segment could extract sensitive configuration data or deploy unauthorized software.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager 中的 SQL 注入可导致跨相邻网络的权限提升。同一网络段上的攻击者可提取敏感配置数据或部署未授权软件。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation without limits in ASP.NET Core enables denial of service. Attackers can exhaust server resources through sustained requests, disrupting application availability.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中无限制的资源分配可导致拒绝服务。攻击者可通过持续请求耗尽服务器资源，破坏应用程序可用性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows network RCE. Database engines are frequent targets for ransomware and data exfiltration, making this a critical patch priority.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE）。数据库引擎常成为勒索软件和数据窃取的攻击目标，因此该漏洞属于关键补丁优先修复项。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server enables network privilege escalation. Exploitation can grant attackers administrative control over database instances and underlying operating systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆溢出可导致网络权限提升。利用该漏洞可使攻击者获得对数据库实例及底层操作系统的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in .NET permits network RCE. Insecure deserialization remains a top-tier web vulnerability class, allowing attackers to bypass security controls and execute payloads remotely.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的不安全反序列化可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE）。不安全的反序列化仍是顶级 Web 漏洞类别之一，允许攻击者绕过安全控制并远程执行有效载荷。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in SQL Server allows local privilege escalation. While requiring local access, this flaw can elevate compromised user accounts to system-level database administrators.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞可导致本地权限提升。尽管需要本地访问权限，但该缺陷可将已攻陷的用户账户提升至系统级数据库管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Python enables local escalation. As a foundational language for automation and backend services, flawed permission handling can undermine application sandboxing.
items.reason_zh: Python 中的权限管理不当可导致本地权限提升。作为自动化和后端服务的基础语言，有缺陷的权限处理会削弱应用程序的沙箱隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables authorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code, jeopardizing database integrity and sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可使经过身份验证的网络攻击者执行任意代码，危及数据库完整性和敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation, risking direct compromise of enterprise database systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可导致基于网络的权限提升，存在企业数据库系统被直接攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in SQLite may lead to local privilege escalation when processing untrusted database queries or malformed data files.
items.reason_zh: SQLite 中的越界读取在处理不受信任的数据库查询或格式错误的数据文件时，可能导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in .NET Framework allows local attackers to bypass security features by manipulating DLL loading order, undermining application sandboxing.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的不可信搜索路径允许本地攻击者通过操纵 DLL 加载顺序来绕过安全功能，从而破坏应用程序沙箱隔离。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges and exfiltrate or modify critical database contents.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入允许经过身份验证的攻击者提升权限，并窃取或修改关键数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Tools for Applications and SSMS enables unauthorized remote code execution, threatening database administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Tools for Applications 和 SSMS 中的代码注入可导致未授权的远程代码执行，威胁数据库管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation limits in ASP.NET Core allow unauthenticated denial of service, significantly impacting web application availability.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源分配限制可导致未认证拒绝服务，严重影响 Web 应用程序的可用性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server enables remote code execution, posing a severe risk to backend data architectures and application servers.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，对后端数据架构和应用服务器构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in .NET and Visual Studio allows unauthorized network code execution, compromising development pipelines and runtime environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET 和 Visual Studio 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致未授权的网络代码执行，破坏开发流水线及运行环境。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server enables remote code execution over a network. Database servers are high-value targets, and this flaw directly compromises data confidentiality and integrity.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致通过网络进行远程代码执行。数据库服务器是高价值目标，该缺陷直接破坏了数据的机密性和完整性。

items.reason_en: SQL Server heap overflow allows unauthorized remote code execution, risking complete database compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 堆溢出可导致未授权的远程代码执行，存在数据库被完全攻陷及数据泄露的风险。

items.reason_en: SQL Server injection flaw enables unauthorized privilege escalation and data manipulation across the database engine.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 注入缺陷可导致未经授权的权限提升及跨数据库引擎的数据篡改。

items.reason_en: SQL Server untrusted pointer dereference allows remote code execution, destabilizing critical data services.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中不受信任的指针解引用可导致远程代码执行，破坏关键数据服务的稳定性。

items.reason_en: SQL Server SQL injection allows privilege escalation over the network, exposing sensitive stored data to unauthorized queries.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server SQL 注入可导致跨网络的权限提升，使敏感存储数据暴露于未授权查询之下。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution. Network-accessible database engines remain high-value targets for data exfiltration and persistence.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许远程代码执行。可网络访问的数据库引擎仍是数据窃取和持久化攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server allows privilege escalation. Confirms that query validation gaps continue to expose enterprise database management systems.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入可导致权限提升。这证实了查询验证漏洞仍在使企业数据库管理系统面临风险。

items.reason_en: Double free in Microsoft Exchange Server enables remote code execution. Email middleware vulnerabilities frequently facilitate lateral movement within corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的双重释放（Double Free）漏洞可导致远程代码执行。邮件中间件漏洞经常助长企业内部网络中的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable session validation flaw allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the Applications Platform Engineering infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 易于利用的会话验证缺陷允许低权限攻击者攻陷应用平台工程基础设施。

items.reason_en: Command injection via the export tool allows administrators to bypass command allowlists and execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: 通过导出工具进行的命令注入允许管理员绕过命令白名单并执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Lack of SAML assertion replay protection compromises single sign-on integrity, risking unauthorized access to enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: 缺乏 SAML 断言重放保护会破坏单点登录（SSO）的完整性，导致企业应用面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel ipv4 socket option handling fails to free memory after an RCU grace period, causing resource leaks. This core OS vulnerability affects broad server and client deployments under concurrent TCP workloads.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 ipv4 套接字选项处理在 RCU 宽限期结束后未能释放内存，导致资源泄漏。此核心操作系统漏洞会影响并发 TCP 工作负载下广泛的服务器和客户端部署。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Active Directory Federation Services enables network-based spoofing attacks, undermining enterprise identity federation and access controls.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的密码学签名验证不当可导致基于网络的欺骗攻击，破坏企业身份联合与访问控制。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature bypass in the .NET runtime weakens software integrity validation, potentially allowing unauthorized code execution across cross-platform deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET runtime 中的加密签名绕过机制削弱了软件完整性验证，可能导致跨平台部署中发生未授权代码执行。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in the Remote Desktop Gateway Service exposes enterprise remote access infrastructure to network-based code execution, impacting secure connectivity management.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中的 use-after-free 漏洞使企业远程访问基础设施面临基于网络的代码执行风险，影响安全连接管理。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in OpenSSH for Windows allows unauthorized remote code execution, impacting cross-platform development and secure shell environments.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的相对路径遍历漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，影响跨平台开发与安全的 Shell 环境。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in OpenSSH for Windows enables network RCE. OpenSSH is a standard remote administration tool, and this flaw provides a direct pathway to server compromise across mixed-OS environments.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可触发网络 RCE。OpenSSH 作为标准远程管理工具，该缺陷为混合操作系统环境下的服务器沦陷提供了直接途径。

items.reason_en: Protection mechanism failure in PowerShell allows local security bypass. PowerShell execution policies and constrained language modes are primary defense layers against malicious scripts; bypassing them neutralizes endpoint detection strategies.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 中的保护机制失效可导致本地安全绕过。PowerShell 执行策略和受限语言模式是防御恶意脚本的主要防线；绕过这些机制将使终端检测策略失效。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Bluetooth Port Driver enables adjacent network privilege escalation. Bluetooth interfaces are increasingly targeted for proximity-based attacks, allowing local privilege gains from nearby devices.
items.reason_zh: Bluetooth Port Driver 中的 use-after-free 漏洞可实现相邻网络权限提升。蓝牙接口日益成为基于近距离攻击的目标，允许攻击者从附近设备获取本地权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the PostScript Printer Driver allows local privilege escalation. Print spooler and driver vulnerabilities remain historically prevalent attack vectors for initial foothold acquisition in Windows environments.
items.reason_zh: PostScript Printer Driver 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升。打印后台处理程序及驱动程序漏洞历来是 Windows 环境中获取初始立足点的最常见攻击向量之一。

items.reason_en: Incorrectly resolved references in Visual Studio Code may disclose sensitive information over the network during development operations.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中引用解析错误可能在开发操作期间通过网络泄露敏感信息。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Hello permits local privilege escalation, potentially undermining biometric security mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hello 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能破坏生物识别安全机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in libheif allows out-of-bounds writes via malformed HEIF files, risking memory corruption in image processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: libheif 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造的 HEIF 文件实现越界写入，危及图像处理流水线中的内存安全。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in Microsoft Office Word triggers remote code execution when processing malicious documents, remaining a primary vector for spear-phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的空指针解引用漏洞在处理恶意文档时会触发远程代码执行，仍是鱼叉式钓鱼攻击的主要向量。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Outlook allows remote code execution via crafted emails, directly impacting end-user productivity and corporate email security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Outlook 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造的邮件实现远程代码执行，直接影响终端用户生产力与企业邮件安全。

items.reason_en: Hyper-V untrusted pointer dereference allows local code execution, threatening virtualization layer security and host isolation.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致本地代码执行，威胁虚拟化层安全与主机隔离性。

items.reason_en: Microsoft Authenticator improper authentication allows local privilege escalation, weakening multi-factor authentication deployments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator 的身份验证不当漏洞可导致本地权限提升，削弱多因素认证部署的安全性。

items.reason_en: Visual Studio heap overflow enables remote code execution, targeting software development environments and build pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中的堆溢出漏洞可触发远程代码执行，针对软件开发环境与构建流水线。

items.reason_en: Microsoft Graphics Component heap overflow allows remote code execution, impacting display rendering subsystems and system stability.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Graphics Component 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响显示渲染子系统与系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Double free in libarchive's RAR5 reader triggers memory corruption during unpacking. Library-level flaws can destabilize diverse applications relying on compressed data processing.
items.reason_zh: libarchive 的 RAR5 读取器中的 double free 漏洞会在解压过程中触发内存损坏。库级缺陷可能导致依赖压缩数据处理的各种应用程序运行不稳定。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in ansible-core via role dependencies compromises automation pipelines. Highlights supply chain and configuration management risks in modern DevOps workflows.
items.reason_zh: 通过角色依赖关系在 ansible-core 中注入参数会破坏自动化流水线。凸显了现代 DevOps 工作流中的供应链与配置管理风险。

items.reason_en: Infinite loop in json-glib's JSONPath evaluator causes denial of service. Parser vulnerabilities in foundational libraries can cascade into broader service disruptions.
items.reason_zh: json-glib 的 JSONPath 求值器中的无限循环会导致拒绝服务（DoS）。基础库中的解析器漏洞可能引发更广泛的服务中断。

items.reason_en: Heap out-of-bounds write in the tokenizer allows memory corruption via crafted GGUF models, posing risks to AI inference pipelines.
items.reason_zh: tokenizer 中的堆越界写入漏洞可通过构造的 GGUF 模型导致内存损坏，对 AI 推理流水线构成风险。

items.reason_en: Attacker-controlled model names interpolated into download URLs risk fetching malicious payloads or triggering unintended network requests.
items.reason_zh: 攻击者可控的模型名称被插入下载 URL 时，存在拉取恶意载荷或触发非预期网络请求的风险。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the issue handler allows remote attackers to execute system commands via manipulated repository states.
items.reason_zh: issue handler 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许远程攻击者通过操纵仓库状态执行系统命令。

items.reason_en: Environment variable manipulation in gettext functions can bypass security restrictions in setuid/setgid programs, affecting system-level applications.
items.reason_zh: gettext 函数中的环境变量篡改可绕过 setuid/setgid 程序的安全限制，影响系统级应用程序。
